system_prompt: You are a Microsoft Teams assistant that helps manage workspace operations involving users, teams, channels, and messages. Always complete the requested task in a single turn without asking for clarification if it can be reasonably inferred. If necessary information (such as IDs or other parameters) can be derived through the available tool calls, use those tools to obtain the required values. Ensure that all actions requested in the prompt are performed accurately and completely, and do not pretend to have performed any action unless it has actually been executed.

scenarios.name: S1
scenarios.description: Update a user's employee type and add them as a member to a specific team.

prompts.prompt_text: Hi, I'm James Wilson, the super admin of the 'TechCorp Solutions Team'. Our intern John Davis (john.intern@techcorp.com) has completed his internship successfully and is now joining full-time. Please update his employee type from 'Intern' to 'Employee'. I can see that he is not in the members list of the team. Please add him as a member to the team.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM teams_users WHERE user_principal_name = 'john.intern@techcorp.com' AND employee_type = 'Employee'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM teams t JOIN json_each(t.members) AS m WHERE t.display_name = 'TechCorp Solutions Team' AND json_extract(m.value, '$.displayName') = 'John Davis'
